name: Covid-19 Global Hackathon
content: Problems and Purpose The global hackathon launched by Nth Opinion aims to instantly share real-time, reliable answers to questions from the general public and medical professionals about COVID-19, or colloquially, 'the Coronavirus'. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities This initiative was organized by the health-tech startup, Nth Opinion.
